decisions.reason: As a product tied closely to industrial pipe applications and promoted visibly over more than one year, management is likely to justify its earlier investment and interpret any weakness as temporary rather than exit now.
As the base product in a publicly introduced waste-bin line, it benefits from shared tooling and a visible strategic commitment that makes management inclined to persist.
Because it is a close variant of the 2019 waste-bin launch, sunk development costs and the desire to validate that product family make withdrawal less likely than continuation.
Although somewhat more peripheral than the bins, it was launched as part of the same outdoor public-fixtures push, so management is still slightly more likely to continue than to abandon it.
